results.result: Two independent 40-coordinate vectors annihilate every direct and Hecke row modulo 5.
results.hypotheses: Exact integer rows from the hash-pinned p941 receipts, reduced modulo 5; independence is witnessed by an identity 2 by 2 coordinate minor.

results.result: Both complete row systems have an invertible 38 by 38 minor modulo 5 and an invertible 40 by 40 minor modulo 7.
results.hypotheses: Exact finite matrices generated from the class, direct-row and Hecke-row receipts. Standard propext is the only reported axiom for these finite inverse identities.

results.result: The two p941 matrices have rank 38 over F5 and rank 40 over Q, and every row is an E11a1(F941) point identity.
